LIFTY — screen designs

Dark warm-charcoal ground, one flame accent. Barlow Condensed for figures, Barlow for text.

These solve the same problems Hevy does, but the look is our own rather than a copy of theirs.

Everything here is a static mockup. Tell me what to change before I build it.

Deliberately absent, per your calls:

no feed, followers or sharing · no rest timer · no muscle heat map · no body measurements · no supersets or warm-up set types · no plate calculator · no RPE · no exercise illustrations

Rest timer is the one I'd bet you end up wanting. Say the word and it goes in.

Two phones, two independent installs. No sync, no accounts, no server.

The only thing that crosses between you is a backup file one of you hands over deliberately.

The PREVIOUS column is the whole app.

Grey "17.5 kg × 8" is what you did last session, set for set. Tap it and the row fills in.

Most sets should need zero typing: tap previous, tap the check. The ±2.5 / ±1 steppers sit under whichever row you're editing, so the keypad rarely opens.

Sized for chalky hands mid-set:

• check box 52×44
• weight field 80×40, reps 66×40
• buttons 48–52 tall

Green means one thing only — that set is banked. Nothing else in the app is green.

Your history lives on the phone and nowhere else, so the backup banner gets loud once you pass a week.

CSV is for reading in Sheets. JSON is the one that can actually be restored — onto a new phone, or hers.
